Japan has the world's third-largest economy by nominal GDP.
The Japanese name for Japan is 'Nihon' or 'Nippon', which means 'sun origin'.
The Japanese bullet train, Shinkansen, can reach speeds of up to 320 km/h (199 mph).
Japan has more than 3,000 McDonald's restaurants, the largest number outside the US.
Tokyo is the world's most populous metropolitan area, with over 37 million residents.
Japan has the highest life expectancy in the world.
There are over 200 volcanoes in Japan.
Japan has a literacy rate of almost 100%.
Japanese trains are among the world's most punctual: their average delay is just 18 seconds.
'Mono no aware' (物の哀れ) is an aesthetic of gentle sadness at the impermanence of things.
